description: Originate a loan from application through underwriting to closing and funding.

steps.description: Receive and log the loan application with borrower details.

inputs.name: borrower-information
inputs.desc: Applicant name, address, SSN, employment, and income

inputs.name: loan-request
inputs.desc: Requested loan amount, purpose, and term

outputs.name: application-record
outputs.desc: Logged application with unique ID and timestamp

outputs.name: document-checklist
outputs.desc: List of required supporting documents

process: Record the borrower details and loan request into the application system.
Assign an application ID and timestamp.
Generate the document checklist based on loan type and borrower profile.

steps.description: Verify the borrower identity and supporting documents.

inputs.name: document-checklist
inputs.desc: Required documents to collect and verify

outputs.name: identity-verification-result
outputs.desc: Pass or fail with details on each verification check

outputs.name: verified-documents
outputs.desc: List of documents received and verified

process: Collect the required documents (pay stubs, tax returns, bank statements, ID).
Verify identity against government databases or third-party services.
Confirm document authenticity and flag any discrepancies.

steps.description: Pull the credit report and summarize the borrower credit profile.

outputs.name: credit-report-summary
outputs.desc: Credit score, trade lines, delinquencies, and inquiries

outputs.name: credit-risk-flags
outputs.desc: Any items requiring underwriter attention

process: Request the credit report from one or more bureaus.
Summarize the score, open accounts, balances, and payment history.
Flag derogatory items, high utilization, or recent inquiries.

steps.description: Underwrite the loan by evaluating income, debt-to-income ratio, and collateral.

outputs.name: underwriting-decision
outputs.desc: Approved, approved with conditions, or denied with rationale

outputs.name: loan-terms
outputs.desc: Final rate, term, conditions, and covenants if approved

process: Calculate the debt-to-income ratio from verified income and existing obligations.
Evaluate the collateral value (appraisal for mortgage, asset verification for secured loans).
Apply the lending criteria and make the credit decision.
Document the rationale and any conditions for approval.

steps.description: Close the loan, execute documents, and fund the proceeds.

outputs.name: closing-package
outputs.desc: Executed loan documents and disclosures

outputs.name: loan-origination-record
outputs.desc: Complete origination record with funding confirmation

process: Verify all conditions of approval are satisfied.
Prepare the closing documents (note, deed of trust, disclosures).
Execute the documents and fund the loan proceeds.
Record the loan in the servicing system.

description: Detect and investigate fraudulent transactions from rule configuration through investigation to reporting.

steps.description: Configure the fraud detection rules and thresholds.

inputs.name: transaction-types
inputs.desc: Types of transactions to monitor (card, ACH, wire, P2P)

inputs.name: risk-parameters
inputs.desc: Velocity limits, amount thresholds, geographic restrictions

outputs.name: detection-rules
outputs.desc: Configured rules with triggers and thresholds

outputs.name: monitoring-scope
outputs.desc: Channels and transaction types covered

process: Define the detection scenarios (velocity, amount, geolocation, device, behavioral).
Set the thresholds for each rule based on historical fraud patterns.
Configure the rule priority and interaction logic.

steps.description: Monitor transactions against the detection rules and flag suspicious activity.

outputs.name: flagged-transactions
outputs.desc: Transactions that triggered one or more rules

outputs.name: alert-queue
outputs.desc: Prioritized queue of alerts for investigation

process: Score each transaction against the active rules.
Flag transactions that exceed the thresholds.
Prioritize the alert queue by risk score and dollar amount.

steps.description: Investigate flagged transactions to confirm or dismiss fraud.

outputs.name: investigation-findings
outputs.desc: Confirmed fraud, false positive, or inconclusive for each alert

outputs.name: evidence-package
outputs.desc: Supporting evidence for each confirmed case

process: Review the transaction details, customer history, and device data.
Contact the account holder if needed to verify the transaction.
Classify each alert as confirmed fraud, false positive, or inconclusive.
Compile the evidence for confirmed cases.

steps.description: File suspicious activity reports and produce the investigation record.

outputs.name: sar-filings
outputs.desc: Suspicious activity reports filed with FinCEN

outputs.name: fraud-investigation-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the investigation and outcomes

process: Prepare the SAR for each confirmed case per FinCEN requirements.
File the report within the regulatory deadline.
Update the fraud case management system with outcomes.
Produce the investigation summary for compliance records.

description: Reconcile payments between payment processor records and bank statements.

steps.description: Collect transaction records from the payment processor.

inputs.name: processor-source
inputs.desc: Payment processor name and access credentials

outputs.name: processor-transactions
outputs.desc: All transactions from the processor for the period

outputs.name: processor-summary
outputs.desc: Totals by type (charges, refunds, fees, payouts)

process: Connect to the payment processor and pull transactions for the period.
Normalize the transaction format (date, amount, reference, type).
Calculate totals by transaction type.

steps.description: Collect the bank statement for the reconciliation period.

outputs.name: bank-transactions
outputs.desc: All transactions from the bank for the period

outputs.name: bank-summary
outputs.desc: Totals by type (deposits, withdrawals, fees)

process: Download or import the bank statement for the period.
Normalize the transaction format to match the processor records.
Calculate totals by transaction type.

steps.description: Match processor transactions to bank transactions by amount, date, and reference.

outputs.name: matched-transactions
outputs.desc: Successfully matched pairs

outputs.name: unmatched-items
outputs.desc: Items with no match on either side

process: Match transactions by exact amount and reference number.
For remaining items, attempt fuzzy matching by date range and amount.
Separate matched pairs from unmatched items on both sides.

steps.description: Investigate and resolve unmatched or discrepant items.

outputs.name: resolution-actions
outputs.desc: Actions taken for each discrepancy (timing, adjustment, error)

outputs.name: reconciliation-report
outputs.desc: Final reconciliation report with matched, resolved, and outstanding items

process: Classify each discrepancy (timing difference, fee, error, missing record).
Investigate and resolve each item or escalate for further review.
Compile the final reconciliation report with all matched, resolved, and outstanding items.

description: Build a credit scoring model with defined criteria, weights, score bands, and historical validation.

steps.description: Define the scoring criteria and data inputs for the credit model.

inputs.name: target-population
inputs.desc: Borrower segment the model will score

inputs.name: available-data-fields
inputs.desc: Data fields available for scoring (bureau, application, behavioral)

outputs.name: scoring-criteria
outputs.desc: Selected criteria with definitions (payment history, utilization, length, mix, inquiries)

outputs.name: data-requirements
outputs.desc: Data sources and fields needed for each criterion

process: Select the criteria based on predictive power and data availability.
Define each criterion with measurement rules and data sources.
Document the exclusions and any criteria considered but rejected.

steps.description: Assign weights to each scoring criterion and calculate the composite score.

outputs.name: weighted-model
outputs.desc: Model with criteria weights and scoring formula

outputs.name: score-range
outputs.desc: Minimum and maximum possible scores

process: Assign initial weights based on historical default correlation.
Calculate the composite score formula.
Define the score range and resolution.

steps.description: Set the score bands and decision thresholds.

outputs.name: score-bands
outputs.desc: Defined bands (excellent, good, fair, poor) with score ranges

outputs.name: decision-thresholds
outputs.desc: Approval, review, and decline thresholds

process: Divide the score range into bands based on risk tiers.
Set the approval, manual review, and decline thresholds.
Document the expected population distribution across bands.

steps.description: Validate the model against historical default rates and produce the model document.

outputs.name: validation-results
outputs.desc: Model performance metrics (KS statistic, Gini, accuracy by band)

outputs.name: scoring-model-document
outputs.desc: Complete model documentation for regulatory and internal use

process: Score the historical population using the model.
Compare predicted risk by band against actual default rates.
Calculate discrimination metrics (KS, Gini, ROC).
Document the model, validation results, and any limitations.

description: Open a new bank account from identity verification through system setup to welcome.

steps.description: Collect the applicant information and account preferences.

inputs.name: applicant-details
inputs.desc: Name, address, date of birth, SSN, employment, and contact information

inputs.name: account-type-request
inputs.desc: Type of account requested (checking, savings, money market, CD)

outputs.name: application-data
outputs.desc: Structured applicant record

outputs.name: account-preferences
outputs.desc: Selected account type and features (overdraft, online, debit card)

process: Record the applicant details into the onboarding system.
Confirm the requested account type and optional features.
Generate the application record with a unique reference.

steps.description: Run KYC, sanctions, and PEP screening on the applicant.

inputs.name: account-preferences
inputs.desc: Account type for risk tier assignment

outputs.name: kyc-result
outputs.desc: Pass, fail, or enhanced due diligence required

outputs.name: screening-record
outputs.desc: Results of sanctions and PEP screening

process: Verify identity against government ID databases.
Screen against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists.
Screen against PEP (politically exposed persons) databases.
Assign the customer risk tier based on screening results.

steps.description: Set up the account in the core banking system.

outputs.name: account-number
outputs.desc: Assigned account number and routing number

outputs.name: account-setup-record
outputs.desc: Account configuration in the core system

process: Create the account record in the core banking system.
Configure the selected features (overdraft, online access, alerts).
Generate the account number and routing details.

steps.description: Issue credentials and welcome materials to the new account holder.

outputs.name: welcome-package
outputs.desc: Login credentials, debit card request, and welcome guide

outputs.name: account-opening-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the account opening process

process: Generate the online banking credentials and send securely.
Initiate the debit card request if selected.
Send the welcome guide with account details and next steps.
Finalize the account opening record.

description: Set up transaction monitoring for anti-money-laundering compliance from scenario definition through tuning.

steps.description: Define the monitoring scenarios and detection logic for AML.

inputs.name: regulatory-requirements
inputs.desc: Applicable AML regulations and examination findings

inputs.name: product-channels
inputs.desc: Products and channels to monitor (deposits, wires, ACH, cards)

outputs.name: monitoring-scenarios
outputs.desc: Defined scenarios (structuring, rapid movement, high-risk geography, round-tripping)

outputs.name: scenario-logic
outputs.desc: Detection logic and parameters for each scenario

process: Identify the required scenarios from regulatory guidance and risk assessment.
Define the detection logic for each scenario (thresholds, time windows, aggregation rules).
Document the rationale for each scenario and its parameters.

steps.description: Configure the detection rules and thresholds in the monitoring system.

outputs.name: configured-rules
outputs.desc: Rules implemented in the monitoring system

outputs.name: threshold-documentation
outputs.desc: Documented thresholds and their basis

process: Translate each scenario into system rules with specific thresholds.
Configure the aggregation windows, customer segmentation, and exclusions.
Document each threshold and its derivation.

steps.description: Backtest the rules against historical data and tune to reduce false positives.

outputs.name: backtest-results
outputs.desc: Alert volumes, true positive rates, and false positive rates by rule

outputs.name: tuned-thresholds
outputs.desc: Adjusted thresholds based on backtest findings

process: Run each rule against 6 to 12 months of historical transaction data.
Measure the alert volume, true positive rate, and false positive rate.
Adjust thresholds to balance detection with manageable alert volumes.
Document the tuning rationale.

steps.description: Set up the alert review workflow and produce the monitoring setup document.

inputs.name: backtest-results
inputs.desc: Expected alert volumes and detection rates

outputs.name: alert-workflow
outputs.desc: Configured alert routing, escalation, and disposition workflow

outputs.name: monitoring-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete documentation of the monitoring program

process: Design the alert triage, investigation, and escalation workflow.
Set the staffing model based on expected alert volumes.
Compile the monitoring setup document for regulatory examination.

description: Set up a digital lending platform from product definition through application flow, decisioning, and servicing.

steps.description: Define the loan products, terms, and eligibility criteria.

inputs.name: capital-constraints
inputs.desc: Available capital, cost of funds, and risk appetite

outputs.name: product-catalog
outputs.desc: Defined loan products with rates, terms, fees, and eligibility criteria

outputs.name: pricing-model
outputs.desc: Rate setting methodology and risk-based pricing tiers

process: Define each loan product (type, amount range, term range, rate range).
Set the eligibility criteria (credit score, income, DTI, geographic).
Build the pricing model with risk-based tiers.

steps.description: Configure the online application flow for borrowers.

outputs.name: application-flow
outputs.desc: Configured online application with fields, document upload, and e-signature

outputs.name: disclosure-templates
outputs.desc: Regulatory disclosures for each product (TILA, ECOA, state-specific)

process: Design the application steps (product selection, personal info, income, consent).
Configure the document upload requirements by product.
Set up the e-signature workflow and regulatory disclosures.

steps.description: Integrate the credit decision engine with the application flow.

outputs.name: decision-engine-config
outputs.desc: Integrated decisioning with automated approval, decline, and manual review rules

outputs.name: decision-audit-trail
outputs.desc: Logging and audit trail configuration for adverse action compliance

process: Connect the credit bureau pull to the application flow.
Configure the automated decision rules (approve, decline, refer to manual review).
Set up adverse action notice generation for declines.
Configure the audit trail for fair lending compliance.

steps.description: Set up the loan servicing system for payments, statements, and collections.

outputs.name: servicing-config
outputs.desc: Configured servicing for payment processing, statements, and escrow

outputs.name: platform-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete platform documentation for operations and compliance

process: Configure the payment processing (ACH, autopay, one-time).
Set up the statement generation and delivery.
Configure the delinquency management and collection workflows.
Compile the platform setup documentation.

description: Manage corporate treasury from cash forecasting through investment and borrowing to daily reconciliation.

steps.description: Forecast the cash position based on expected inflows and outflows.

inputs.name: expected-cash-flows
inputs.desc: Scheduled inflows (receivables, revenue) and outflows (payables, payroll, debt service)

outputs.name: cash-forecast
outputs.desc: Daily and weekly cash position forecast

outputs.name: liquidity-gaps
outputs.desc: Periods where cash is projected below minimum or above investment threshold

process: Aggregate current balances across all bank accounts.
Map expected inflows and outflows by date.
Project the daily cash position and identify surplus or deficit periods.

steps.description: Invest surplus cash according to the investment policy.

inputs.name: liquidity-gaps
inputs.desc: When surplus cash is available and for how long

outputs.name: investment-actions
outputs.desc: Investments placed (money market, T-bills, commercial paper, repos)

outputs.name: investment-positions
outputs.desc: Current portfolio with maturities and yields

process: Identify the surplus amount and duration from the forecast.
Select instruments within the investment policy (tenor, credit quality, concentration limits).
Execute the investments and record the positions.

steps.description: Manage the borrowing facilities for deficit periods.

inputs.name: investment-positions
inputs.desc: Available investments that could be liquidated

outputs.name: borrowing-actions
outputs.desc: Draws on credit facilities or liquidations executed

outputs.name: facility-utilization
outputs.desc: Current utilization of each borrowing facility

process: Evaluate whether to draw on a facility or liquidate an investment.
Execute the draw or liquidation to cover the shortfall.
Update the facility utilization and covenant tracking.

steps.description: Reconcile the daily cash position and produce the treasury report.

outputs.name: reconciled-position
outputs.desc: Actual versus forecast cash position reconciliation

outputs.name: treasury-management-report
outputs.desc: Daily treasury report with positions, actions, and variances

process: Compare actual balances against the forecast.
Identify and explain variances.
Compile the daily treasury report with all positions, actions, and yield metrics.

description: Manage chargebacks from notification through evidence gathering and representment to outcome tracking.

steps.description: Receive the chargeback notification and log the case.

inputs.name: chargeback-notification
inputs.desc: Notification from the card network or processor with reason code and amount

outputs.name: chargeback-case
outputs.desc: Logged case with reason code, amount, deadline, and original transaction

outputs.name: response-deadline
outputs.desc: Calendar date by which the representment must be submitted

process: Log the chargeback with all details from the notification.
Look up the original transaction and customer record.
Calculate the response deadline from the reason code and network rules.

steps.description: Gather evidence to support the representment.

outputs.name: evidence-package
outputs.desc: Compiled evidence (receipts, shipping proof, communications, AVS/CVV results)

outputs.name: representment-viability
outputs.desc: Assessment of whether representment is likely to succeed

process: Identify the required evidence based on the reason code.
Collect transaction receipts, delivery confirmations, and customer communications.
Assess the strength of the evidence and likelihood of success.

steps.description: Prepare and submit the representment package.

outputs.name: representment-record
outputs.desc: Submitted representment with confirmation

outputs.name: case-status
outputs.desc: Pending, represented, or accepted (loss)

process: If viable, prepare the representment letter with evidence attached.
Submit through the processor or network portal before the deadline.
If not viable, accept the chargeback and update the case status.

steps.description: Track the outcome and analyze chargeback patterns.

outputs.name: outcome-record
outputs.desc: Final resolution (won, lost, pre-arbitration) with financial impact

outputs.name: chargeback-management-report
outputs.desc: Pattern analysis by reason code, merchant, and time period

process: Record the final outcome when the network responds.
Calculate the financial impact (amount recovered or lost, fees).
Analyze patterns by reason code, product, and merchant to identify root causes.
Recommend process changes to reduce future chargebacks.

description: Produce and file regulatory reports for a financial institution from data collection through submission.

steps.description: Identify the required reports and filing deadlines.

inputs.name: institution-type
inputs.desc: Charter type and regulators (OCC, FDIC, Fed, state)

outputs.name: required-reports
outputs.desc: List of reports due (call report, HMDA, CRA, BSA, FR Y-9C) with deadlines

outputs.name: data-requirements
outputs.desc: Data fields and sources needed for each report

process: Identify all reports required based on institution type, size, and charter.
Determine the filing deadlines for the reporting period.
Map the data requirements for each report to source systems.

steps.description: Collect and aggregate data from source systems for reporting.

outputs.name: collected-data
outputs.desc: Aggregated data sets for each report

outputs.name: data-quality-flags
outputs.desc: Items failing validation or requiring manual review

process: Extract data from the core system, general ledger, and ancillary systems.
Aggregate and transform to match the reporting schema.
Run validation checks and flag items that fail.

steps.description: Generate the report in the required format and validate against regulatory rules.

outputs.name: generated-reports
outputs.desc: Reports in the required format (XML, XBRL, CSV, PDF)

outputs.name: validation-results
outputs.desc: Results of edit checks and cross-report consistency

process: Generate each report in the format required by the regulator.
Run the regulatory edit checks (quality, validity, reasonability).
Fix any failures and regenerate until clean.

steps.description: Submit the reports and archive for examination.

outputs.name: submission-confirmations
outputs.desc: Filing confirmations from each regulator

outputs.name: regulatory-reporting-record
outputs.desc: Complete archive of data, reports, validations, and submissions

process: Submit each report through the regulator's filing system.
Confirm acceptance and log the confirmation numbers.
Archive the complete package (data, report, validations, confirmation) for examination.
